semiconductor_relevance: Medium — Polyfluor Plastics specializes in high-performance fluoropolymers and plastics that can be utilized in semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Polyfluor Plastics BV has over 35 years of experience in the plastics industry, focusing on high-quality fluoropolymers and other advanced plastics. They provide tailored solutions for semiconductor applications, including bespoke products designed for specific manufacturing needs.
capabilities: High pressure hoses suitable for cleanroom environments
Heat shrink tubing for electronic components
Custom-designed plastic solutions for manufacturing processes

regional_presence.Benelux: Polyfluor Plastics has the largest assortment of fluoroplastic products in the Benelux region and delivers worldwide.
